 This is Recall / Restoration Application No. 762 of
2008 along with Delay Condonation Application No. 4096
of 2008, for restoration of Contempt Petition No. 16 of
2005.

2) Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the
affidavit accompanying delay condonation application.

The cause shown for delay in filing the recall / restoration
application is found sufficient. Therefore, the delay is
condoned. The delay condonation application is allowed.
3) Also, heard on recall / restoration application.
4) Brief facts of the case are that applicant / petitioner
filed Writ Petition No. 875 of 2004 (S/S) for payment of
post retiral dues, which was allowed on 28.07.2004 with
the direction that the District Education Officer, Pauri
Garhwal shall make all payments relating to post retiral
benefits along with 9 per cent interest thereon. In February
2005, Contempt Petition No. 16 of 2005 is moved by the
applicant / petitioner complaining wilful disobedience of
the courts order passed on 28.07.2004, in the writ petition.
Notices were issued to the respondents / opposite parties,
namely Sri Mahabir Singh Bisht, Zila Basic Shiksha
Adhikari, Pauri Garhwal and Sri H.S. Baunal, Finance and
Accounts Officer, Basic Education, Pauri Garhwal. The
contempt petition was dismissed by this Court vide order
dated 28.08.2006, as infructuous, after Additional Advocate
General made a statement that in compliance of order
passed in the writ petition, post retiral dues have been paid
to the petitioner, and as far as the interest part is concerned,
State Government has been moved for sanctioning the
funds.
5) Learned counsel for the applicant / petitioner does
not deny that the petitioner has received post retiral benefits
and the grievance remains only in respect of the interest
part.

6) In the above circumstances, this Court does not find
any error in the order dated 28.08.2006, passed by this
Court in Civil Contempt Petition No. 16 of 2005.
Therefore, the recall / restoration application is rejected
with the observation that the applicant / petitioner is at
liberty to file a fresh contempt petition for alleged wilful
disobedience of the courts order for non-payment of the
interest awarded by the Court. (No order need be passed in
Impleadment Application No. 4097 of 2008, in the above
circumstances, which also stands disposed of).

(Prafulla C. Pant, J.)
